## Duties, Responsibilities, and Authorities of the Board of Directors

The Board of Directors is in charge of carrying out all actions related to the management of the Company for the benefit of the Company and following the purposes and objectives of the Company. The Board of Directors is also responsible for representing the Company, both inside and outside the court, regarding all matters and all events with restrictions as stipulated in the laws and regulations, the Company's Articles  of  Association,  and/or  GMS  Resolutions.  To  support  the effectiveness of the implementation of duties and responsibilities, the Board of Directors may form a committee or team.

The authorities of the Board of Directors are as follows:

1. Establishing policies that are deemed  appropriate in the management of the Company.
2. Regulating the delegation of powers of the Board of Directors to represent the Company inside and outside the court to one or several members of the Board of Directors who are specifically appointed for this purpose, including the Company's employees, either individually or jointly and/or other entities.
3. Regulating  provisions  regarding  Company  employees  including the  determination  of  wages,  pensions  or  old-age  benefits,  and other income for Company employees based on the prevailing laws and regulations.
4. Appointing and dismissing Company employees based on the  Company's  internal  regulations  and  applicable  laws  and regulations.
5. Appointing and dismissing the Corporate Secretary and/or Head of  the  Internal  Audit  Unit  with  the  approval  of  the  Board  of Commissioners.
6. Writing  off  bad  debts  with  the  provisions  as  stipulated  in  the Articles of Association and subsequently submitted to the Board of Commissioners and reported, and accounted for in the Annual Report.
7. No  longer  collect  interest  receivables,  fines,  fees  and  other receivables other than the principal carried out in the context of restructuring and/or settlement of receivables as well as other actions to settle the Company's receivables with the obligation to  report  to  the  Board  of  Commissioners  which  the  provisions and  procedures  for  reporting  are  determined  by  the  Board  of Commissioners.
8. Performing all other actions and actions regarding the management and  ownership  of  the  Company's  assets,  binding the Company with other parties and/ or other parties with the Company, and representing the Company inside and outside the court regarding all matters and all events, with the restrictions as regulated in the laws and regulations, the Company's Articles of Association and/or GMS Resolutions.
9. Proposing  Company  representatives  to  become  candidates  for members of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners in joint ventures and/or subsidiaries that make  significant contributions and/or strategic value as determined by the GMS.

Kewajiban Direksi adalah sebagai berikut:

1.  Mengusahakan dan menjamin terlaksananya usaha dan kegiatan Perusahaan  sesuai  dengan  maksud  dan  tujuan  serta  kegiatan usahanya.
2.  Menyiapkan pada waktunya Rencana Jangka Panjang Perusahaan untuk 5 (lima) tahun ke depan, serta Rencana  Kerja dan Anggaran Perusahaan Tahunan dan rencana kerja lainnya serta perubahannya untuk disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris dan mendapatkan persetujuan Dewan Komisaris.
3.  Membuat Daftar Pemegang Saham, Daftar Khusus, Risalah RUPS, dan Risalah Rapat Direksi.
4. Membuat  Laporan  Tahunan  yang  antara  lain  berisi  Laporan Keuangan, sebagai wujud pertanggungjawaban pengurusan Perusahaan, serta dokumen keuangan Perusahaan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam undang-undang tentang Dokumen Perusahaan.
5.  Menyusun Laporan Keuangan Perusahaan berdasarkan Standar Akuntansi  Keuangan  (SAK)  yang  berlaku  dan  menyerahkan kepada Akuntan Publik untuk diaudit.
6. Menyampaikan  Laporan  Tahunan  setelah  ditelaah  oleh  Dewan Komisaris  dalam  jangka  waktu  paling  lambat  5  ( lima )  bulan setelah  tahun  buku  Perusahaan  berakhir  kepada  RUPS  untuk disetujui dan disahkan.
7.  Memberikan penjelasan kepada RUPS mengenai Laporan Tahunan.
8.  Menyampaikan  Neraca  dan  Laporan  Laba  Rugi yang telah disahkan  oleh  RUPS  kepada  Menteri  yang  membidangi  Hukum sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
9. Menyusun  laporan  lainnya yang  diwajibkan oleh  ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
10. Memelihara  dan  menyimpan  di  tempat  kedudukan  Perusahaan Daftar  Pemegang Saham, Daftar Khusus, Risalah RUPS, Risalah Rapat  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Risalah  Rapat  Direksi,  Laporan Tahunan  dan  dokumen  keuangan  Perusahaan,  serta  dokumen Perusahaan lainnya.
11. Mengadakan dan memelihara pembukuan  dan  administrasi Persero Perusahaan dan sesuai dengan kelaziman yang berlaku bagi suatu Perusahaan.
12. Menyusun  sistem  akuntansi  sesuai  dengan  Standar  Akuntansi Keuangan dan berdasarkan prinsip-prinsip pengendalian intern, terutama  fungsi  pengurusan,  pencatatan,  penyimpanan  dan pengawasan.
13. Memberikan  laporan  berkala  menurut  cara  dan  waktu  sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, serta laporan lainnya setiap kali diminta oleh Dewan Komisaris dan/atau Pemegang Saham Seri A  Dwiwarna,  dengan  memperhatikan  peraturan  perundangundangan khususnya peraturan di Bidang Pasar Modal berlaku.
14. Menyiapkan  susunan  organisasi  Perusahaan  lengkap  dengan perincian dan tugasnya.
15. Memberikan penjelasan tentang segala hal yang ditanyakan atau yang diminta Anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Pemegang Saham Seri A Dwiwarna, dengan memperhatikan peraturan perundangundangan khususnya peraturan di Bidang Pasar Modal berlaku.
16. Melaporkan  penetapan  Anggota  Direksi  dan  Dewan  Komisaris pada  anak  perusahaan  dan/atau  perusahaan  patungan  kepada Dewan Komisaris.

The obligations of the Board of Directors are as follows:

1. Striving for and ensuring the implementation of the Company's business and activities following the aims and objectives as well as its business activities.
2.  Preparing on time the Company's Long-Term Plan for the next 5  (five)  years,  as  well  as  the  Company's  Annual  Budget  and Operational Plan in and other work plans and amendments to be submitted to the Board Commissioners and obtain approval from the Board of Commissioners.
3. Making a Register of Shareholders, Special Register, Minutes of GMS, and Minutes of Meeting of the Board of Directors.
4. Preparing  an  Annual  Report,  which  includes  among  others the  Financial  Statements,  as  a  form  of  accountability  for  the management of the Company, as well as the Company's financial documents as referred to in the law on Company Documents.
5. Preparing  the  Company's  Financial  Statements  based  on  the applicable Financial Accounting Standards (SAK) and submit them to the Public Accountant for audit.
6. Submitting the Annual Report after being reviewed by the Board of Commissioners within a period of no later than 5 (five) months after the Company's fiscal year ends to the GMS for approval and approval.
7. Providing  an  explanation  to  the  GMS  regarding  the  Annual Report.
8. Submitting the Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Report which has been approved by the GMS to the Ministry in charge of Law following the provisions of the legislation.
9. Preparing  other  reports  required  by  the  provisions  of  the legislation.
10. Maintaining  and  keeping  at  the  domicile  of  the  Company  the Register  of  Shareholders,  Special  Register,  Minutes  of  GMS, Minutes of Meeting of the Board of Commissioners, and Minutes of Meeting of the Board of Directors, Annual Report and Company financial documents, as well as other Company documents.
11. Holding  and  maintaining  the  bookkeeping  and  administration of  Persero  Companies  and  follow  the  prevailing  norms  for  a Company.
12. Developing an accounting system following Financial Accounting Standards  and  based  on  the  principles  of  internal  control, especially the functions of management, recording, storage, and supervision.
13. Providing  periodic  reports  according  to  the  method  and  time following applicable regulations, as well as other reports whenever  requested  by  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and/or Dwiwarna  Series  A  Shareholder,  with  due  observance  of  the prevailing  laws  and  regulations,  especially  regulations  in  the Capital Market Sector.
14. Preparing the organizational structure of the Company complete with details and duties.
15. Providing  an  explanation  of  all  matters  asked  or  requested  by Members of the Board of  Commissioners  and  Shareholders  of Series A Dwiwarna, taking into account the prevailing laws and regulations, especially regulations in the Capital Market Sector.
16. Reporting  the  determination  of  the  members  of  the  Board  of Directors and the Board of Commissioners in subsidiaries and/or joint ventures to the Board of Commissioners.

<!-- image -->

17. Menyusun  sistem/pedoman  pengukuran  dan  penilaian  kinerja untuk divisi dalam organisasi (struktural) yang diterapkan secara objektif dan transparan minimal memuat:
- a. Prosedur operasional standar atas pengukuran dan penilaian kinerja untuk unit dan jabatan (struktural) dalam Perusahaan; serta
- b. Penjelasan mengenai Indikator Kinerja minimal berupa formula/rumus,  cara-cara  penilaian,  informasi  sumber  data, saat pelaporan.
- c. Menyusun pencapaian kinerja masing-masing Direktorat berdasarkan  target-target  yang  ditetapkan  dalam  Kontrak Manajemen sebagai Laporan pencapaian target kinerja masing-masing dan disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris.
- d. Memastikan sosialisasi infrastruktur GCG ke seluruh karyawan dan stakeholders seperti Code of Conduct, Code of Corporate Governance,  Board  Manual ,  RJPP,  RKAP,  Kebijakan  LHKPN, Kebijakan Gratifikasi, Kebijakan Whistle Blowing System, Charter SPI, Charter komite-komite Dewan Komisaris, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Perusahaan serta kebijakankebijakan lain, dapat berjalan konsisten dan berkelanjutan.
- e.  Menjalankan kewajiban-kewajiban lainnya sesuai dengan ketentuan  yang  diatur  dalam  Anggaran  Dasar  ini  dan  yang ditetapkan oleh RUPS.

## Ruang Lingkup Pembagian Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Direksi

Dalam  menjalankan  tugas  pengelolaan  Perusahaan,  pembagian tugas dan wewenang Direksi ditetapkan oleh RUPS. Dalam hal RUPS tidak menetapkan pembagian tugas dan wewenang tersebut. Untuk itu, Direksi mengatur sendiri pembagian kerja di antara para anggota untuk kelancaran tugasnya.

Pembagian tugas dan wewenang Direksi sebagai berikut:

- Direktur Utama
- a.  Menyusun dan mengkoordinasikan penyusunan Rencana Bisnis;
- b.  Mengawasi pelaksanaan dan pencapaian Rencana Kerja Setiap saat;
- c. Melaporkan kondisi kinerja keuangan maupun kinerja operasional lainnya kepada Dewan Komisaris;
- d.  Melakukan supervisi langsung pada Unit Kerja yang dipimpinnya;
- e.  Menandatangani Nota Kesepahaman ( Memorandum of Understanding );
- f. Menandatangani  Perjanjian/Kontrak dengan  nilai di atas Rp1.000.000.000,- (satu miliar Rupiah);
- g.  Menandatangani Cek, Bilyet Giro dengan nilai di atas Rp1.000.000.000,- (satu miliar Rupiah) bersama-sama dengan 1 (satu) anggota Direksi lainnya;
- h.  Menandatangani surat-surat yang berhubungan dengan Direktorat Utama;
- i. Menandatangani Surat Keputusan Direksi (SK);
- j. Menandatangani Surat Keputusan Direksi (SK) Pengangkatan pegawai tetap dan Pemberhentian Pegawai;
- k. Memimpin rapat Direksi;
- l. Mengambil alih tugas anggota Direksi lainnya yang berhalangan.
17. Developing  a  system/guideline  for  measuring  and  assessing performance  for  divisions  within  the  organization  (structural) that is applied objectively and transparently, at least containing:
- a. Standard operating procedures for measuring and evaluating performance  for  units  and  (structural)  positions  within  the Company; as well as
- b. Explanation  of  the  minimum  Performance  Indicators  in  the form  of  formulas,  methods  of  assessment,  information  on data sources, at the time of reporting.
- c. Preparing the performance achievement of each Directorate based on the targets set out in the Management Contract as a report on the achievement of each performance target and submitted to the Board of Commissioners.
- d.  Ensuring the socialization of GCG  infrastructure to all employees and stakeholders such as Code of Conduct, Code of Corporate Governance, Board Manual, RJPP, ABOP, LHKPN Policy,  Gratification  Policy,  Whistle  Blowing  System  Policy, SPI  Charter,  Board  of  Commissioners  Committee  Charter, Standard The Company's Operating Procedures (SOP) as well as other policies, can run consistently and sustainably.
- e. Carrying out other obligations following the provisions stipulated in these Articles of Association and determined by the GMS.

## Scope of Division of Duties and Responsibilities of the Board of Directors

In carrying out the management duties of the Company, the division of duties and authorities of the Board of Directors is determined by the GMS. If the GMS does not determine the division of duties and authorities. To that end, the Board of Directors regulates the division of work among the members for the smooth running of their duties.

The division of duties and authorities of the Board of Directors is as follows:

- President Director
- a. Developing  and  coordinating  the  preparation  of  a  Business Plan;
- b.  Supervising  the  implementation  and  achievement  of  the Work Plan at any time;
- c. Reporting the condition of financial performance and other operational performance to the Board of Commissioners;
- d. Carrying out direct supervision of the Work Unit led;
- e.  Signing a Memorandum of Understanding (Memorandum of Understanding);
- f. Signing an Agreement/Contract with a value above Rp1,000,000,000,- (one billion Rupiah);
- g. Signing Cheques, Bilyet Giro (Demand Deposits) with a value of more than Rp1,000,000,000 (one billion Rupiah) together with 1 (one) member of the Board of Directors;
- h. Signing letters related to the Main Directorate;
- i. Signing the Decree of the Board of Directors (SK);
- j. Signing the Decree  of  the  Board  of  Directors  (SK)  on  the Appointment of Permanent Employees and Dismissal of Employees;
- k. Presided over the meeting of the Board of Directors;
- l. Taking  over  the  duties  of  other  members  of  the  Board  of Directors who are unable to attend.

- Direktur Operasional
- a. Menyusun strategi dan arah kebijakan Rencana Bisnis sesuai dengan tanggung jawabnya dalam bidang operasional;
- b.  Bertanggung jawab untuk mengawasi pelaksanaan dan pencapaian Rencana Kerja pada Direktoratnya setiap saat;
- c. Melakukan supervisi langsung termasuk menyusun kebijakan dan prosedur serta melakukan review kinerja pada unit kerja yang dipimpinnya;
- d. Menandatangani Surat Perjanjian/Kontrak dan/atau Surat Perintah Kerja  yang  terkait  dengan  Direktorat  Operasional  dengan  nilai maksimal sebesar Rp5.000.000.000,- (lima miliar Rupiah);
- e. Menandatangani  Cek,  Bilyet  Giro  dengan  nilai  maksimal sampai sebesar Rp5.000.000.000,(lima miliar Rupiah) bersama-sama dengan 1 (satu) anggota Direksi lainnya;
- f. Menandatangani surat-surat yang berhubungan dengan Direktur Operasional.
- Direktur Keuangan dan SDM
- a. Menyusun strategi dan arah kebijakan Rencana Bisnis sesuai dengan tanggung jawabnya dalam bidang Keuangan dan SDM;
- b.  Bertanggung jawab untuk mengawasi pelaksanaan dan pencapaian Rencana Kerja pada Direktoratnya setiap saat;
- c. Melakukan supervisi langsung termasuk menyusun kebijakan dan prosedur serta melakukan review kinerja pada unit kerja yang dipimpinnya;
- d.  Menandatangani  Cek,  Bilyet  Giro  dengan  nilai  maksimal sampai sebesar Rp1.000.000.000,(satu miliar Rupiah) bersama-sama dengan 1 (satu) anggota Direksi lainnya;
- e. Menandatangani  Perjanjian  Kerja  Waktu  Tertentu  (PKWT), Perjanjian Outsourcing ;
- f. Menandatangani perjanjian dengan pihak mitra/ supplier yang berkaitan dengan Direktorat Keuangan dan SDM dengan nilai maksimal sebesar Rp1.000.000.000,- (satu miliar Rupiah);
- g.  Menandatangani surat-surat yang berhubungan dengan Direktorat Keuangan dan SDM; Menandatangani Surat Keputusan  Direksi  (SK)  yang  berhubungan  dengan  pegawai kecuali  Pengangkatan  pegawai  tetap  dan  Pemberhentian Pegawai.

## Laporan Singkat Pelaksanaan Tugas Direksi Tahun 2022

Direksi memiliki kewenangan dalam bertanggung jawab penuh atas pengurusan Perusahaan untuk kepentingan dan tujuan Perusahaan. Sesuai  dengan  tugasnya  masing-masing,  di  tahun  2022  Direksi telah  melaksanakan  pengelolaan  operasional  Perusahaan  secara efektif dan efisien dalam mencapai target usaha, melalui berbagai keputusan strategis yang mencakup, namun tidak terbatas pada:

1. Rencana korporasi dan rencana bisnis;
2. Pengelolaan sumber daya Perusahaan secara efektif dan efisien;
3.  Manajemen operasional dan keuangan;
4. Evaluasi usaha Perusahaan;
5.  Perhatian atas kepentingan pemangku kepentingan;
6.  Penyusunan RJPP &amp; RKAP 2021;
7. Pencapaian KPI.

Pelaksanaan tugas Direksi  juga  dilakukan  melalui  rapat  kerja  rutin yang  dilakukan  secara  internal  dengan  anggota  Direksi,  ataupun manajemen terkait, dan rapat gabungan dengan Dewan Komisaris.

- Director of Operations
- a. Developing the strategy and policy direction of the Business Plan following its responsibilities in the operational field;
- b.  Responsible for supervising the implementation and achievement of the Work Plan at the Directorate at any time;
- c. Performing direct supervision including formulating policies and procedures as well as reviewing the performance of the work units they lead;
- d.  Signing a Letter of Agreement/Contract and/or a Work Order related  to  the  Directorate  of  Operations  with  a  maximum value of Rp5,000,000,000 (five billion Rupiah);
- e. Signing Checks, Bilyet Giro with a maximum value of up to Rp Rp5,000,000,000  (five  billion  Rupiah)  together  with  1  (one) member of the Board of Directors;
- f. Signing letters related to the Director of Operations.
- Director of Finance and HR
- a. Developing strategies and policy directions for the Business Plan following its responsibilities in the field of Finance and HC;
- b.  Responsible for supervising the implementation and achievement of the Work Plan at the Directorate at any time;
- c. Performing direct supervision including formulating policies and procedures as well as reviewing the performance of the work units they lead;
- d.  Signing Cheques, Bilyet Giro with a maximum value of up to Rp1,000,000,000  (one  billion  Rupiah)  together  with  1  (one) member of the Board of Directors;
- e. Signing a Specific Time Work Agreement (PKWT), Outsourcing Agreement;
- f. Signing  agreements  with  partners/suppliers  related  to  the Directorate  of  Finance  and  HC  with  a  maximum  value  of Rp1,000,000,000 (one billion Rupiah);
- g. Signing letters related to the Directorate of Finance and HC; Signing  the  Decree  of  the  Board  of  Directors  (SK)  relating to  employees  except  for  the  appointment  of  permanent employees and dismissal of employees.

## Board of Directors's Task Reports of 2022

The Board of Directors has the authority in being fully responsible for the management of the Company for the interest and objectives of  the  Company. By their respective duties, in 2022, the Board of Directors had implemented the Company's operational management effectively  and  efficiently  in  achieving  business  targets,  through various strategic decisions which include, but are not limited to:

1. Corporate plan and business plan;
2. Effective and efficient management of the Company's resources;
3. Operational and financial management;
4. Evaluation of the Company's business;
5. Stakeholder's Interests;
6.  Preparation of CLP &amp; ABOP2021;
7. KPI achievement.

The  implementation  of  the  Board  of  Directors'  duties  is  also conducted through regular internal work meetings with members of the Board of Directors, or related management, and joint meetings with the Board of Commissioners.

<!-- image -->

Sesuai  dengan  cakupan  tugas  Direksi  di  atas,  pada  tahun  2022, pelaksanaan  tugas  Direksi  terkait  realisasi  program  kerja  adalah sebagai berikut:

1.  Melanjutkan pengembangan usaha end-to-end peternakan ayam dengan mengelola kandang GPS dan PS;
2. Menciptakan pasar baru dan bersaing dengan perusahaan serupa dengan melakukan pengembangan bisnis untuk branding produk dan peningkatan volume penjualan dengan menciptakan jaringan retailer dengan model kemitraan usaha dimana akses permodalan melibatkan perbankan;
3.  Pengembangan bisnis sapi dan domba kambing untuk pemenuhan kebutuhan Qurban dalam setahun melalui sinergi BUMN dengan melibatkan  Program  Kemitraan  Penggemukan  sapi  dan  domba kambing dengan kelompok ternak;
4. Meningkatkan kualitas (service level agreement) perusahaan melalui peningkatan kompetensi dan kapasitas SDM dan kehandalan sistem teknologi informasi yang sudah diaplikasikan (ERP);
5. Perbaikan  proses  investasi  dan  distribusi  mulai  dari  penilaian kepastian pasar guna kelayakan investasi, mengubah pembiayaan ke pembiayaan kapital sebagai efisiensi, penerapan manajemen risiko  (three  lines  of  defense),  juga  skema  pembiayaan  dengan berbagai alternatif yang menguntungkan; dan
6. Perbaikan tata kelola perusahaan, proses bisnis, struktur organisasi dan penerapan aspek hukum terkait.

## Penilaian Kinerja Organ Pendukung Direksi

Tugas pengelolaan Perusahaan yang dilakukan DIreksi memperhatikan masukan dan rekomendasi yang disampaikan oleh para  komite  pendukung  melalui  laporan  berkala  dan  pertemuan rutin.  Direksi  juga  memanfaatkan  organ  pendukungnya  sebagai perpanjangan tangan dalam mengelola Perusahaan. Per 31 Desember 2022, Direksi memiliki komite pendukung yang terdiri dari Sekretaris Perusahaan dan Group Satuan Pengawas Internal.

Penilaian  kinerja  komite  Direksi  dilakukan  berdasarkan  pada  tugas dan  kewajiban  yang  tercantum  dalam  ketentuan  mengenai  tugas dan tanggung jawab serta program kerja. Kriteria penilaian kinerja meliputi  realisasi  laporan  pelaksanaan  tugas,  rekomendasi  yang diberikan  dan  kehadiran  dalam  rapat  untuk  membantu  fungsi pengelolaan Direksi.

Di  tahun  2022,  Direksi  menilai  bahwa  seluruh  organ  pendukung di  bawahnya  telah  menjalankan  tugas  dengan  baik  dan  efektif sesuai  dengan  tanggung  jawab  masing-masing  organ  pendukung. Sekretaris Perusahaan telah membantu Direksi dalam hal pencapaian target, penyelesaian sengketa hukum atas lahan milik Perusahaan, perbaikan proses standarisasi dan kepatuhan, monitoring dokumen legalitas  Perusahaan,  dan  peningkatan  kualitas  dan  kompetensi SDM.  Begitu  pula  dengan  Group  Satuan  Pengawas,  dinilai  telah menjalankan tugasnya dengan baik dalam hal audit, utang piutang, monitoring tindak lanjut temuan audit eksternal, penyusunan manual internal  audit  Berdikari,  penyusunan  SOP  SPI,  serta  reviu  surat perjanjian kerja sama.

<!-- image -->

In  accordance  with  the  scope  of  duties  of  the  Board  of  Directors above, in 2022, the implementation of the duties of the Board of Directors  related  to  the  realization  of  the  work  program  was  as follows:

1. Continue the development of end-to-end chicken farming business by managing GPS and PS cages;
2. Create  new  markets  and  compete  with  similar  companies  by conducting  business  development  for  product  branding  and increasing  sales  volume  by  creating  a  retailer  network  with  a business  partnership  model  where  access  to  capital  involves banks;
3. Business development of cattle and goats to meet the needs of Qurban in a year through the synergy of SOEs by involving the Fattening Partnership Program for cattle and goats with livestock groups;
4. Improving the quality (service level agreement) of the company through  increasing  the  competence  and  capacity  of  human resources  and  the  reliability  of  the  information  technology system that has been applied (ERP);
5. Improving the investment and distribution process starting from assessing  market  certainty  for  investment  feasibility,  changing financing  to  capital  financing  as  efficiency,  implementing  risk management  (three  lines  of  defense),  as  well  as  financing schemes with various profitable alternatives; and
6. Improvement of corporate governance, business processes, organizational structure and implementation  of related legal aspects.

## Performance Assessment of the Supporting Organs of the Board of Directors

The management duties of the Company conducted by the Board of Directors pays great attention to the inputs and recommendations submitted by the supporting committees through periodic reports and  regular  meetings.  The  Board  of  Directors  also  utilizes  its supporting committee as an extension of the management of the Company. As of December 31, 2022, the Board of Directors had the supporting  committee  consisting  of  the  Corporate  Secretary  and Internal Audit Unit Group.

The performance appraisal of the Board of Directors committee is carried out based on the duties and obligations stated in the provisions regarding duties  and  responsibilities  as  well  as  the  work  program.  Performance appraisal criteria include the realization of the report on the implementation of duties, recommendations given, and attendance at meetings to assist the management function of the Board of Directors.

In  2022,  the  Board  of  Directors  considered  that  all  supporting organs below them had carried out their duties well and effectively in  accordance  with  the  responsibility  of  each  supporting  organ. The  Corporate  Secretary  has  assisted  the  Board  of  Directors  in achieving targets, resolving legal disputes over land owned by the Company,  improving  standardization  and  compliance  processes, monitoring Company legal documents, and improving the quality and competence of human resources. Likewise with the Audit Unit Group, it was considered has carried out its duties well in terms of audits, accounts payable, monitoring of follow-up on external audit findings, preparation of Berdikari's internal audit manual, preparation of SPI SOPs, as well as review of cooperation agreements.

## TRANSPARANSI INFORMASI DEWAN KOMISARIS DAN DIREKSI

Transparency of Information of The Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors

## ASESMEN  PENERAPAN  GCG  UNTUK  DEWAN KOMISARIS DAN DIREKSI

Dalam  menjaga  efektivitas  pelaksanaan  kinerja  Dewan  Komisaris dan Direksi sebagai organ utama dalam Perusahaan maka asesmen terhadap kedua organ tersebut menjadi sebuah keharusan. Penilaian tersebut  dilakukan  sesuai  dengan  standar  BUMN,  sebagaimana status  Berdikari  sebagai  bagian  dari holding BUMN.  Pelaksanaan asesmen  juga  harus  diukur  secara  berkala  setiap  tahunnya  untuk menilai perkembangan Perusahaan dalam mempertahankan implementasi GCG yang berkelanjutan.

Asesmen  penerapan  GCG  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi  mengacu kepada  Salinan  Keputusan  Sekretaris  Kementerian  Badan  Usaha Milik  Negara  No.  SK-16/S.MBU/2012  tanggal  6  Juni  2012  tentang Indikator/Parameter  Penilaian  dan  Evaluasi  atas  Penerapan  Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik atau Good Corporate Governance (GCG) pada  BUMN.  Hasil  penilaian  di  tahun  2022  dilakukan  secara self assessment dengan pendampingan oleh Kantor Jasa Akuntan Endang Martiwi,  CA,  dengan  perolehan  nilai  secara  berturut-turut  untuk Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi adalah 30,35 dan 30,71. Nilai ini lebih tinggi dari penilaian tahun sebelumnya yang sebesar 29,10 dan 29,84 untuk  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi  secara  berturut-turut.  Hal  ini terjadi karena Perusahaan telah menindaklanjuti arahan berdasarkan hasil penilaian GCG di tahun sebelumnya. Perusahaan terus berupaya untuk  mengoptimalkan  dan  meningkatkan  penerapan  GCG  sesuai dengan standar terbaik dan berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan nilai asesmen setiap tahunnya.

## Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Dewan  Komisaris  melakukan  pengukuran  dan  penilaian  terhadap kinerja Dewan Komisaris dengan mengacu pada Board Manual yang disahkan  oleh  SK  No.  069/05/BDK/DIR/XII/2018,  kriteria  evaluasi kinerja Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi ditetapkan berdasarkan acuan utama  yaitu  RKAP  di  tahun  berjalan.  Dewan  Komisaris  memiliki program kerja secara kolegial dan masing-masing anggota memiliki tugasnya sendiri-sendiri. Sedangkan  Direksi, sebagai pengelola Perusahaan,  bertanggung  jawab  untuk  melakukan  segala  upaya mencapai proyeksi  kinerja  Perusahaan:  laba  rugi,  neraca,  arus  kas, rasio keuangan, KPI, tingkat kesehatan perusahaan. Dewan Komisaris bertanggung  jawab  terhadap Key Performance Indicators (KPI) sendiri, sedangkan Direksi memiliki KPI Perusahaan sebagai bagian dari tanggung jawab mereka. Walaupun demikian, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi memiliki bertanggung jawab terhadap realisasi Laporan Manajemen per semester yang menjadi dasar penilaian kinerja setiap organ terhadap kinerja bisnis secara keseluruhan.

## GCG IMPLEMENTATION ASSESSMENT FOR THE BOARD  OF  COMMISSIONERS  AND  BOARD  OF DIRECTORS

In  maintaining  the  effectiveness  of  implementing  the  Board  of Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors  performance  as  the  main organs  in  the  Company,  the  assessment  to  those  two  organs  is  a must.  The  assessment  is  conducted  in  accordance  with  the  SOEs standards, as the status of Berdikari as part of the holding SOEs. The implementation of assessment must also be measured periodically every  year  to  assess  the  Company's  progress  in  maintaining  a sustainable GCG implementation.

The  assessment  of  the  GCG  implementation  by  the  Board  of Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors  refers  to  a  copy  of  the Decree of the Secretary of the Ministry of State-Owned Enterprises No.  SK-16/S.MBU/2012  on  June  6,  2012,  concerning  Indicators/ Parameters of Assessment and Evaluation of the Implementation of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) in the SOEs. In 2022, the results of  assessment  were  conducted  through  self-assessments  assisted by  Endang  Martiwi  CA.  Accounting  Firm,  with  the  scores  for  the Board  of  Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors  were  30.35  and 30.71, respectively. These values were higher than the assessment in the previous year of 29.10 and 29.84, respectively, for the Board of  Commissioners and Board of Directors. This occurred since the Company has followed up directives based on the results of the GCG assessment in the previous year. The Company continues to strive for optimizing and improving the implementation of GCG in accordane with the best standards and is committed to increase the assessment value every year.

## Performance Assessment of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors

The Board of Commissioners measures and assesses the performance of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  by  referring  to  the  Board  Manual which  was  approved  by  SK  No.  069/05/BDK/DIR/XII/2018,  the performance  evaluation  criterias  for  the  Board  of  Commissioners and Board of Directors are determined based on the main reference, namely  the  ABOP  for  the  year.  The  Board  of  Commissioners  has a  collegial  work  program  and  each  member  has  his/her  duties. Meanwhile, the Board of Directors, as the manager of the Company, is  responsible  for  making  every  effort  to  achieve  the  projected performance of the Company: profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow,  financial  ratios,  KPI,  company  soundness  level.  The  Board  of Commissioners  is  responsible  for  the  Key  Performance  Indicators (KPI),  while  the  Board  of  Directors  has  the  Company's  KPI  as  part of  their  responsibilities.  However,  the  Board  of  Commissioners and  Board  of  Directors  are  responsible  for  the  realization  of  the Management Report per semester which is the basis for evaluating the performance of each organ on the overall business performance.

## Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Dalam  pemberian  remunerasi  bagi  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi, Perusahaan  mengedepankan  prinsip  kehati-hatian  serta  mengacu pada peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Terkait penetapan  besaran  remunerasi  bagi  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi Perusahaan untuk tahun buku 2021, ditetapkan berdasarkan keputusan  Pemegang  Saham  yang  disesuaikan  dengan  Peraturan Menteri  BUMN  No.  PER-12/MBU/11/2020  tanggal  22  Desember

## Remuneration  for  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and Board of Directors

In  providing  remuneration  for  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and Board of Directors, the Company prioritizes the principle of prudence and  refers  to  the  applicable  laws  and  regulations.  Regarding  the determination  of  the  amount  of  remuneration  for  the  Company's Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors for the 2021 Fiscal Year, it is determined based on the Shareholders' Resolution which is  adjusted  to  the  Regulation  of  the  Ministry  of  SOEs  No.  PER-12/

2020  tentang  Perubahan  Kelima  atas  Peraturan  Menteri  BUMN No.  PER-04/MBU/2014  tentang  Pedoman  Penetapan  Penghasilan Direksi, Dewan Komisaris dan Dewan Pengawas BUMN.

Berdasarkan  peraturan  tersebut,  komponen  remunerasi  Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi terdiri dari:

1. Gaji/Honorarium;
2.  Tunjangan;
3. Fasilitas; dan
4. Tantiem/Insentif Kinerja/Insentif Khusus.

Usulan  Remunerasi  juga  mengacu  pada  beberapa  pertimbangan antara lain perbandingan dengan besaran remunerasi tahun sebelumnya,  kenaikan  kompleksitas  operasional  Perusahaan,  serta perbandingan besaran remunerasi dengan perusahaan yang sejenis, pencapaian KPI serta tingkat  kesehatan  Perusahaan.  Adapun  total remunerasi Direksi di tahun 2022 adalah sebesar Rp8.046.272.727,sedangkan untuk Dewan Komisaris sebesar Rp3.036.727.272,-.

MBU/11/2020 on December 22, 2020, regarding the Fifth Amendment to  the  Regulation  of  the  Ministry  of  SOEs  No.  PER-04/MBU/2014 concerning Guidelines for Determining the Income of Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners, and Supervisory Board of the SOEs.

Based on these regulations, the components of remuneration for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors consist of:

1. Salary/Honorarium;
2. Allowances;
3. Facilities; and
4. Tantiem/Performance Incentives/Special Incentives.

The  remuneration  proposal  also  refers  to  several  considerations, including  the  comparison  with  the  previous  year's  remuneration amount, the increase in the complexity of the Company's operations, as well as the comparison of the remuneration amount with similar companies,  the  achievement  of  KPIs,  and  the  company's  level  of soundness. In 2022, total remuneration for the Board of Directors was  Rp8,046,272,727,-  while  total  remuneration  for  the  Board  of Commissioners was Rp3,036,727,272,-.

## RAPAT DIREKSI

Rapat  Direksi  dilakukan  apabila  dipandang  perlu  oleh  seorang atau lebih anggota Direksi. Penyelenggaraan rapat dapat diadakan atas  permintaan  tertulis  dari  seorang  atau  lebih  anggota  Dewan Komisaris. Pemegang Saham juga berhak untuk mengadakan rapat Direksi, sesuai dengan persyaratan berlaku, jika diperlukan. Di tahun 2022, Direksi telah menyelenggarakan rapat sebanyak 20 kali dengan dengan  agenda  dan  hal-hal  yang  didiskusikan  dalam  rapat  selalu berkaitan  dengan  kinerja  Perusahaan,  progres  pencapaian  target Perusahaan, laporan keuangan, serta hal lainnya yang dianggap perlu. Pada setiap rapat, Direksi menghasilkan beberapa putusan dan juga arahan  kepada  Manajemen  Perusahaan  seputar  upaya  pencapaian target ataupun kebijakan strategis lainnya.

Rapat  yang  diselenggarakan  di  tahun  2022  juga  dihadiri  seluruh anggota Direksi serta pada Group Head Business dan personel terkait lainnya  bila  diperlukan.  Semua  pihak  yang  dibutuhkan  hadir  telah mengikuti rapat dengan baik, tanpa ada ketidakhadiran.

## BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING

The meeting of the Board of Directors is conducted if deemed necessary by  one  or  more  members  of  the  Board  of  Directors.  The  meeting may be held at the written request of one or more members of the Board of Commissioners. The shareholders are also entitled to hold a meeting of the Board of Directors, following applicable requirements, if necessary. In 2022, the Board of Directors had held 20 meetings with the agenda and matters discussed in the meeting are always related to the Company's performance, the progress of achieving the Company's targets, financial reports, and other matters deemed necessary. At each meeting, the Board of Directors produces several decisions and also directives to the Company's Management regarding efforts to achieve targets or other strategic policies.

In 2022, the meeting held was also attended by all members of the Board of  Directors  as  well  as  Group  Heads  of  Business  and  other relevant personnel if necessary. All parties required to attend have attended the meeting well, without any absences.

## TRAINING  AND  COMPETENCY  DEVELOPMENT FOR  THE  BOARD  OF  COMMISSIONERS  AND BOARD OF DIRECTORS

The Company provides opportunity for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors to improve their competence which its implementation is adjusted with the Company's objectives and strategies. The competency improvement programs can be in the form of various training programs, seminars,  socialization  of  regulations/policies,  and  comparative  studies. The implementation of the competency improvement program is adjusted to the work plans of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors as well as the needs of the Company.

Information related  to  the  training  and  competency  improvement activities  that  were  attended  by  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and Board of  Directors  throughout  2022  can  be  seen  in  the  Company Profile chapter of this annual report.

## PENGUNGKAPAN HUBUNGAN AFILIASI

Affiliation Disclosure

## INFORMASI PEMEGANG SAHAM UTAMA/ PENGENDALI

Pemegang  Saham  Utama/Pengendali  Berdikari  adalah  Pemerintah Republik Indonesia dengan kepemilikan saham sebesar 100%.

## PENGUNGKAPAN  HUBUNGAN  AFILIASI ANTARA  DIREKSI,  DEWAN  KOMISARIS, DAN PEMEGANG SAHAM UTAMA/ PENGENDALI

Di antara sesama anggota Dewan  Komisaris, sesama Direksi maupun antara anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi Perusahaan, serta Komite lainnya tidak terdapat hubungan afiliasi sebagaimana dimaksud  dalam  ketentuan  tentang  Tata  Kelola  Perusahaan  yang Baik.

Pengungkapan  hubungan  afiliasi  mencakup  hubungan  keluarga dan  hubungan  keuangan.  Bentuk  hubungan  keuangan  termasuk di  antaranya utang-piutang, kerja sama bisnis, dan lain sebagainya. Bentuk hubungan keluarga mencakup hubungan istimewa terutama yang disebabkan hubungan pertalian darah seperti suami/istri/anak/ orang tua/saudara kandung/ipar, dan sebagainya.

## INFORMATION ON THE MAJOR/ CONTROLLING SHAREHOLDERS

The Major/Controlling Shareholders of Berdikari is the Government of the Republic of Indonesia with 100% share ownership.

## DISCLOSURE OF AFFILIATION BETWEEN THE  BOARD  OF  DIRECTORS,  BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS, AND MAJOR/ CONTROLLING SHAREHOLDERS

Among the fellow members of the Board of Commissioners, fellow Board  of  Directors  and  among  the  members  of  the  Company's Board  of  Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors,  as  well  as  other Committees, there is no affilitation as referred to in the provisions on Good Corporate Governance.

The disclosure of affiliation includes family relationship and financial relationship.  The  form  of  financial  relationship  including,  among others, debts, business partnership, and so on. The form of family relationship includes special relationship, especially which is caused by blood relation such as husband/wife/children/parents/siblings/inlaws, and so on.

Dalam  hal  ini,  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi  telah  memahami ketentuan yang terdapat di Board Manual mengenai rangkap jabatan. Di mana Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi dilarang merangkap jabatan lain yang dapat menimbulkan benturan kepentingan secara langsung dengan Perusahaan, yang dilarang sebagaimana diatur dalam Anggaran  Dasar,  dan/atau  yang  bertentangan  dengan  ketentuan peraturan  perundang-undangan  yang  berlaku.  Anggota  Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi juga telah menandatangani pernyataan tidak memiliki  benturan kepentingan (Pakta Integritas) dan menyatakan secara  tertulis  hal-hal  yang  berpotensi  menimbulkan  benturan kepentingan terhadap dirinya dan menyampaikannya kepada RUPS, serta mematuhi  peraturan perundang-undangan  yang berlaku, termasuk  dengan  tidak  melibatkan  diri  pada  perdagangan  orang dalam ( insider trading ) untuk memperoleh keuntungan pribadi.

Informasi  mengenai  rangkap  jabatan  dari  Dewan  Komisaris  dan Direksi  di  perusahaan/institusi  lain  dapat  ditemukan  di  Bab  Profil Perusahaan pada Laporan Tahunan ini.

In this case, the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors have understood the  provisions  contained  in  the  Board  Manual  regarding concurrent positions. Where members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors are prohibited to hold other positions that may cause a direct conflict of interest with the Company, which is prohibited as  stipulated  in  the  Articles  of  Association,  and/or  which  is  contrary to the provisions of the applicable laws and regulations. Members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors have also signed a statement that they have no conflict of interest (Integrity Pact) and stated  in  writing  matters  that  have  the  potential  to  cause  a  conflict of interest against themselves and submitted them to the GMS, and complied  with  the  applicable  laws  and  regulations,  including  by  not involving themselves on insider trading for personal gain.

Information regarding the concurrent positions of the  Board of  Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors  in  other  companies/ institutions  can  be  found  in  the  Company  Profile  Chapter  of  this Annual Report.

## KEBERAGAMAN KOMPOSISI DEWAN KOMISARIS DAN DIREKSI

## DIVERSITY IN THE COMPOSITION  OF THE BOARD  OF  COMMISSIONERS  AND  BOARD  OF DIRECTORS

Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi  sesuai  dengan  fungsinya  masingmasing memiliki tanggung jawab untuk menjaga kelangsungan usaha Perusahaan. Untuk itu, keberagaman komposisi sangat diperlukan, khususnya terkait pengambilan keputusan dalam pelaksanaan fungsi pengawasan  dan  fungsi  operasional  dengan  mempertimbangkan berbagai aspek yang lebih luas untuk merealisasikan tujuan dalam mencapai  target  usaha.  Komposisi  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi pun juga memperlihatkan keberagaman dari sisi gender di mana di masing-masing organ terdapat satu orang perempuan yang mengisi jabatan.

Berikut  keberagaman  komposisi  yang  dimiliki  oleh  masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi Perusahaan:

The Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors in accordance with  its  respective  functions,  have  responsibility  to  maintain  the Company's  business  continuity.  For  this  reason,  diversity  in  the composition is significantly required, especially related to decisionmaking  in  the  implementation  of  supervisory  and  operational functions  by  considering  a  wider  range  of  aspects  to  realize  its goals and achieve business targets. The composition of the Board of  Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors  also  shows  diversity  in terms of gender wherein each organ is occupied by at least a female executive.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Sekretaris Dewan Komisaris

Sekretaris Dewan Komisaris bertugas:

1. Sekretariat Dewan Komisaris bertugas melakukan kegiatan untuk membantu  Dewan  Komisaris  dalam  melaksanakan  tugasnya berupa:
- a. Mempersiapkan rapat, termasuk bahan rapat ( briefing sheet ) Dewan Komisaris;
- b. Membuat  risalah  rapat  Dewan  Komisaris  sesuai  ketentuan anggaran dasar Perusahaan;
- c. Mengadministrasikan dokumen Dewan Komisaris, baik surat masuk, surat keluar, risalah rapat maupun dokumen lainnya;
- d.  Menyusun  Rancangan  Rencana  Kerja  dan  Anggaran  Dewan Komisaris;
- e.  Menyusun Rancangan Laporan-Laporan Dewan Komisaris;
- f. Melaksanakan tugas lain dari Dewan Komisaris.
2. Sekretaris Dewan Komisaris selaku pimpinan Sekretariat, melaksanakan tugas lain berupa:
- a. Memastikan  bahwa  Dewan  Komisaris  mematuhi  peraturan perundang-undangan serta menerapkan prinsip-prinsip GCG;
- b.  Memberikan informasi yang dibutuhkan oleh Dewan Komisaris secara berkala dan/atau sewaktu-waktu apabila diminta;
- c. Mengkoordinasikan  anggota  Komite,  jika  diperlukan  dalam rangka memperlancar tugas Dewan Komisaris;
- d.  Sebagai penghubung ( liaison officer ) Dewan Komisaris dengan pihak lain.
3. Dalam  rangka  tertib  administrasi  dan  pelaksanaan  tata  kelola Perusahaan yang baik, Sekretariat Dewan  Komisaris wajib memastikan dokumen  penyelenggaraan kegiatan tersimpan dengan baik di Perusahaan.

## Duties  and  Responsibilities  of  the  Secretary  of  the Board of Commissioners

Commissioners is responsible for:

1. The  Secretary  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  is  tasked  with carrying  out  activities  to  assist  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in carrying out its duties in the form of:
- a. Preparing  meetings,  including  meeting  materials  (briefing sheet) of the Board of Commissioners;
- b.  Preparing minutes of the Board of Commissioners meetings in accordance with the provisions of the Company's articles of association;
- c. Administering  documents  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners, including incoming  letters, outgoing  letters, minutes  of meetings and other documents;
- d. Draft the Work Plan and Budget of the Board of Commissioners;
- e. Draft reports of the Board of Commissioners;
- f. Carry out other duties of the Board of Commissioners.
2. The Secretary of the Board of Commissioners as the head of the Secretariat, carries out other duties in the form of:
- a. Ensuring that the Board of Commissioners complies with laws and regulations and implements GCG principles;
- b. Providing information required by the Board of Commissioners periodically and/or at any time if requested;
- c. Coordinating Committee members, if necessary, in order to expedite the duties of the Board of Commissioners;
- d. Serve as a liaison officer of the Board of Commissioners with other parties.
3. In the context of orderly administration and the implementation of good corporate governance, the Secretariat of the Board of Commissioners shall ensure that the documents for organizing activities are properly stored in the Company.

## KOMITE AUDIT

## Audit Committee

Komite Audit  adalah  komite  yang  dibentuk  oleh  Dewan  Komisaris yang  berfungsi  untuk  membantu  Dewan  Komisaris  melakukan pengawasan  atas  pelaksanaan  fungsi  Direksi  dalam  pengelolaan Perusahaan sesuai dengan  prinsip GCG, nilai-nilai, serta etika Perusahaan.

Komite Audit Perusahaan diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Dewan Komisaris.  Ketua  Komite  Audit  adalah  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris Independen atau yang dapat bertindak independen. Anggota Komite Audit dapat berasal dari anggota Dewan Komisaris atau dari luar  Perusahaan.  Pelaksanaan  tugas  dan  tanggung  jawab  Komite Audit Perusahaan berpedoman pada keputusan terakhir Perusahaan mengenai Komite Audit yaitu Keputusan Dewan Komisaris Nomor: 01/KEP/KOM/BDK/VIII/2017 tanggal 1 September 2017.

## Kualifikasi Menjadi Anggota Komite Audit

Komite  Audit  diangkat  dan  diberhentikan  oleh  Dewan  Komisaris dan  dilaporkan  kepada  pemegang  saham  melalui  RUPS.  Adapun persyaratan  untuk  menjadi  anggota  Komite  Audit  adalah  sebagai berikut:

1. Memiliki integritas yang baik dan pengetahuan serta pengalaman kerja yang cukup di bidang pengawasan/pemeriksaan;
2. Tidak memiliki kepentingan/keterkaitan pribadi yang dapat menimbulkan dampak negatif dan konflik kepentingan;
3. Mampu bekerja dengan baik dan berkomunikasi secara efektif.

## Masa Jabatan

Jabatan  anggota  Komite  Audit  yang  bukan  merupakan  anggota Dewan Komisaris Perusahaan paling lama 3 (tiga) tahun dan dapat diperpanjang satu kali selama 2 (dua) tahun masa jabatan, dengan tidak mengurangi hak Dewan Komisaris untuk memberhentikannya sewaktu-waktu. Sedangkan anggota Komite Audit yang merupakan anggota Dewan Komisaris memiliki masa jabatan yang sama dengan jabatannya sebagai anggota Dewan Komisaris.

Anggota Komite Audit yang telah berakhir masa jabatannya dapat diangkat  kembali  hanya  untuk  1  (satu)  kali  masa  jabatan  selama 2  (dua)  tahun,  dengan  tidak  mengurangi  hak  Dewan  Komisaris sewaktu-waktu dalam meninjau dan memberhentikan keanggotaan Komite Audit. Ketua dan Anggota Komite Audit periode tahun 2022 merupakan  anggota  yang  dilantik  berdasarkan  Keputusan  Dewan Komisaris  Nomor:    KEP-02/KOM/X/2022  tanggal  26  Oktober  2022 tentang  Pemberhentian dan Pengangkatan Anggota Komite Audit PT Berdikari.

Berikut susunan anggota Komite Audit per 31 Desember 2022:

The Audit Committee is a committee established by the Board of Commissioners  to  assist  the  Board  of  Commissioners  conducting supervision over the implementation of the functions of the Board of Directors in the management of the Company in accordance with the GCG principles, values, and ethics of the Company.

The Company's Audit Committee which is appointed and dismissed by the Board  of  Commissioners.  The  Chairman  of  the  Audit Committee is a member of the Independent Commissioner or who can act independently. Members of the Audit Committee can come from members of the Board of Commissioners or from outside the Company.  The  implementation  of  duties  and  responsibilities  of the Company's Audit Committee is guided by the Company's latest decree  regarding  the  Audit  Committee,  namely  the  Decree  of the  Board  of  Commissioners  No:  01/KEP/  KOM/BDK/  VIII/2017  on September 1, 2017.

## Member Qualification of the Audit Committee

The Audit Committee is appointed and dismissed by the Board of Commissioners and reported to shareholders through the GMS. The requirements to become a member of the Audit Committee are as follows:

1. High integrity and sufficient knowledge and work experience in the field of supervision/inspection;
2. Not  related  personally  that  can  cause  negative  impacts  and conflicts of interest;
3. Able to work excellently and communicate effectively.

## Term of Office

The  position  of  members  of  the  Audit  Committee  who  are  not members of the Company's Board of Commissioners is a maximum of 3 (three) years and can be extended once for 2 (two) years, without prejudice to the right of the Board of Commissioners to dismiss them at any time. Meanwhile, members of the Audit Committee who are members of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  have  the  same  term  of office as members of the Board of Commissioners.

Members of the Audit Committee whose term of office has ended may be reappointed only for 1 (one) term of office for 2 (two) years, without  prejudice  to  the  right  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  at any  time  to  review  and  terminate  the  membership  of  the  Audit Committee. The Chairman and Members of the Audit Committee in the period of 2022 are members who are appointed based on the Decree  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  No:    KEP-02/KOM/X/2022 on  October  26,  2022,  on  the  Dismissal  and  Appointment  of  Audit Committee Members of PT Berdikari.

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi dibentuk dan bertanggung jawab kepada  Dewan  Komisaris  untuk  membantu  pelaksanaan  tugas Dewan  Komisaris  dalam  hal  menentukan  kebijakan  nominasi  dan remunerasi bagi anggota-anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi.

## Kualifikasi  Menjadi  Anggota  Komite  Nominasi  dan Remunerasi

Anggota Komite Audit harus memenuhi persyaratan:

1. Memiliki integritas yang baik dan pengetahuan serta pengalaman kerja yang cukup di bidang nominasi dan remunerasi;
2. Tidak memiliki kepentingan/keterkaitan pribadi yang dapat menimbulkan dampak negatif dan benturan kepentingan terhadap Perusahaan;

Commissioners and perform other tasks related to the duties of the Board of Commissioners, including:

1. Assisting the Board of Commissioners to ensure the effectiveness of the internal control system and the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties of the external auditor and internal auditor.
2. Assessing  the  implementation  of  activities  and  the  results  of audits carried out by the Internal Audit Unit and external auditors.
3.  Providing recommendations regarding the improvement of the management control system and its implementation.
4. Ensuring that there is a satisfactory evaluation procedure for all information issued by the Company.
5. Identifying  matters  that  require  the  attention  of  the  Board  of Commissioners and other duties of the Board of Commissioners.

## Nomination and Remuneration Committee

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee  is established and  responsible  to  the  Board  of  Commissioners  to  assist  the implementation of duties of the Board of Commissioners in terms of determining the nomination and remuneration policy for members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors.

## Qualifications to be a Member of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee

Audit Committee members must fulfill the following requirements:

1.  Have good integrity and sufficient knowledge and work experience in the field of nomination and remuneration;
2. Have no personal interests/relationships that may have a negative impact and conflict of interest on the Company;

## Independensi Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Adapun pernyataan independensi masing-masing Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi sebagai berikut:

1. Tidak  memiliki  hubungan  keuangan,  hubungan  kepengurusan, kepemilikan saham dan/atau hubungan keluarga dengan anggota Dewan Komisaris lainnya dan Direksi yang dapat mempengaruhi kemampuan saya untuk bertindak independen dalam melaksanakan tugas guna mewujudkan prinsip Good Corporate Governance dalam pemenuhan peraturan perundang-undangan serta peraturan hukum lainnya.

## Independence  of  the  Nomination  and  Remuneration Committee

The statement of independence of each Nomination and Remuneration Committee is as follows:

1. Have no financial relationship, management relationship, share ownership  and/or  family  relationship  with  other  members  of the  Board  of  Commissioners  and  the  Board  of  Directors  that may  affect  my  ability  to  act  independently  in  carrying  out  my duties to realize the principles of Good Corporate Governance in compliance with laws and regulations and other legal regulations.

2. Bahwa  pelaksanaan  tugas  akan  kami  lakukan  dengan  penuh kehati-hatian (duty of care and of loyalty) demi untuk kepentingan yang terbaik  bagi  perusahaan,  dengan  mengindahkan  berbagai sumber  informasi,  keterangan  dan  melakukan  perbandingan yang  cukup,  sebagaimana  layaknya  pihak  profesional  dalam posisi yang sama melakukan hal serupa, atau sebagaimana kami mempertimbangkan keputusan bagi kepentingan diri kami sendiri (Prudent person rule);
3. Bahwa  pelaksanaan  tugas  tidak  akan  kami  lakukan  dengan melibatkan kepentingan pribadi atau dengan tujuan untuk  memperoleh  manfaat  bagi  diri  saya  sendiri,  maupun menguntungkan pihak - pihak yang terkait dengan diri saya, atau pihak  yang  terafiliasi  dengan  saya,  dan  dengan  demikian  maka setiap  Keputusan  yang  saya  ambil  dalam  rangka  pengawasan Perusahaan tidak akan memiliki posisi yang mengandung potensi benturan kepentingan (Conflict of Interest Rule);
4.  Bahwa setiap Keputusan dalam rangka pengawasan Perusahaan akan  kami  ambil  berdasarkan  kepada  pemahaman  yang  cukup tentang berbagai peraturan dan kewajiban normatif lainnya yang terkait dan saya akan mematuhi seluruh ketentuan dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, termasuk pertimbangan best practice, yang dipandang perlu, penting dan kritikal dalam proses tersebut (duty of care and of loyalty).

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bertugas dan bertanggung jawab dalam:

1. Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bekerja secara kolektif dalam melaksanakan tugasnya membantu Dewan Komisaris.
2.  Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bersifat mandiri baik dalam  pelaksanaan  tugasnya  maupun  dalam  pelaporan,  dan bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Dewan Komisaris.
3.  Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bertugas untuk:
- a. Melakukan  review  secara  berkala  atas  Sistem  Pengelolaan Talenta (Talent Management  System) Perusahaan serta monitoring dan evaluasi atas pelaksanaannya;
- b.  Melakukan evaluasi terhadap Sistem dan prosedur Pengklasifikasian Talenta (Talent Classification) yang dilakukan oleh Direksi;
- c. Melakukan validasi dan kalibrasi atas Talenta yang diusulkan oleh Direksi kepada Dewan Komisaris (Selected Talent), untuk menghasilkan  daftar  Talenta  yang  akan  dinominasikan  oleh Dewan Komisaris kepada RUPS/Menteri (Nominated Talent);
- d. Melakukan  evaluasi  terhadap  Calon  Wakil  Perusahaan  yang akan diusulkan sebagai anggota Direksi atau anggota Dewan Komisaris perusahaan anak, sebelum diajukan kepada RUPS/ Menteri;
- e. Melakukan evaluasi atas usulan Key Performance Indicators Individu anggota Direksi;
- f. Menyiapkan  usulan  sistem  evaluasi  kinerja  individu bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
- g.  Menyiapkan  usulan  program  pengembangan  bagi  anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
2. Carry out our duties with the utmost care (duty of care and of loyalty) in the best interest of the company, taking into account various sources of information, information and making sufficient comparisons, as befits professionals in the same position doing the same thing, or as we consider decisions for our own interests (Prudent person rule);
3. That the implementation of our duties will not be carried out by involving personal interests or with the aim of obtaining benefits for  myself,  or  benefiting  parties  related  to  myself,  or  parties affiliated with me, and thus every decision I make in the context of supervising the Company will not have a position that contains potential conflicts of interest (Conflict of Interest Rule);
4. That any Decision in the context of the supervision of the Company will be made based on an adequate understanding of the various regulations and other relevant normative obligations and I will comply with all  applicable  laws  and  regulations,  including  best practice considerations, which are deemed necessary, important and critical in the process (duty of care and of loyalty).

## Tasks and Responsibilities

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is responsible for:

1. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee works collectively in carrying out its duties to assist the Board of Commissioners.
2. The  Nomination  and  Remuneration  Committee  is  independent both in  carrying  out  its  duties  and  in  reporting,  and  is  directly responsible to the Board of Commissioners.
3. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is responsible for:
- a. Conduct periodic reviews of the Company's Talent Management System as well as monitorin and evaluation of its implementation;
- b. Evaluate  the  Talent  Classification  System  and  procedures carried out by the Board of Directors;
- c. Validate and calibrate the Talent proposed by the Board of Directors  to  the  Board  of  Commissioners  (Selected  Talent), to produce a list of Talent to be nominated by the Board of Commissioners to the GMS/Minister (Nominated Talent);
- d.  Evaluate prospective Company Representatives who will be proposed as members of the Board of Directors or members of the Board of Commissioners of subsidiaries, before being submitted to the GMS/Minister;
- e. Evaluate the proposed Key Performance Indicators of Individual members of the Board of Directors;
- f. Prepare a proposal for an individual performance evaluation system  for  members  of  the  Board  of  Directors  and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;
- g.  Prepare proposals for development programs for members of  the  Board  of  Directors  and/or  members  of  the  Board  of Commissioners;

- h. Melakukan evaluasi atas kebijakan remunerasi bagi pegawai yang  membutuhkan  persetujuan/  tanggapan  dari  Dewan Komisaris.
- i. Melakukan  evaluasi  atas  usulan  Direksi  mengenai  struktur organisasi perusahaan.

## ORGAN PENDUKUNG DIREKSI

Board of Directors' Supporting Organs

## SEKRETARIS PERUSAHAAN

Sekretaris  Perusahaan  merupakan  organ  tata  kelola  perusahaan yang  berfungsi  sebagai  penghubung  antara  Perusahaan  dengan pihak  eksternal  termasuk  Pemerintah  Indonesia,  regulator,  dan masyarakat. Sekretaris Perusahaan juga berperan untuk memastikan Perusahaan  telah  mematuhi  peraturan-peraturan  yang  berlaku, terutama di bidang pasar modal.

## DASAR PENGANGKATAN SEKRETARIS PERUSAHAAN

Pengangkatan dan pemberhentian Sekretaris Perusahaan dilakukan oleh  Direktur  Utama  berdasarkan  mekanisme  internal  Perusahaan dengan persetujuan Dewan  Komisaris. Hal ini sesuai dengan Peraturan Menteri Negara BUMN Nomor: PER-09/MBU/2012 tahun 2012  tentang  Perubahan  Atas  Peraturan  Menteri  Negara  Badan Usaha  Milik  Negara  Nomor  PER-01/MBU/2011  tentang  Penerapan Tata  Kelola  Perusahaan  yang  Baik  (Good  Corporate  Governance) pada Badan Usaha Milik Negara.

## Profil Sekretaris Perusahaan

Di tahun 2022, Sekretaris Perusahaan dipimpin oleh Dheni Kamavina selaku Group Head Corporate Secretary &amp; IT . Pengangkatan tersebut berdasarkan SK 034/05/BDK/DIR-01/VI/2020 tanggal 17 Juni 2020 tentang Pengangkatan Pegawai Tetap PT Berdikari.

## CORPORATE SECRETARY

The  Corporate  Secretary  is  a  corporate  governance  organ  that functions  as  a  liaison  between  the  Company  and  external  parties including the Government of Indonesia, regulators and the public. The  Corporate  Secretary  also  plays  a  role  in  ensuring  that  the Company  complies  with  applicable  regulations,  particularly  in  the capital market sector.

## DEED OF APPOINTMENT OF CORPORATE SECRETARY

The  appointment  and  dismissal  of  the  Corporate  Secretary  is carried  out  by  the  Main  Director  based  on  the  Company's  internal mechanism with the approval of the Board of Commissioners. This is  in  accordance  with  the  Regulation  of  the  State  Ministry  of  SOE No:  PER-09/MBU/2012  concerning  Amendment  to  the  Regulation of  the  Ministry  of  SOE  No:  PER-01/MBU/2011  concerning  the Implementation  of  Good  Corporate  Governance  in  State-Owned Enterprises.

## SATUAN PENGAWASAN INTERNAL

Internal Audit Unit

Untuk  mendukung  praktik  Tata  Kelola Perusahaan  yang  Baik, Perusahaan telah memiliki Audit Internal yang dijalankan oleh Group Internal  Audit yang  bertanggung  jawab  langsung  kepada  Direktur Utama berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Direksi PT Berdikari No. 065/05/ BDK/DIR-01/VIII/2021 tanggal 31 Agustus 2021 tentang Penetapan Struktur Organisasi PT Berdikari.

Audit internal merupakan bagian dari pengendalian internal, yang  secara  garis  besar  bertujuan  untuk  membantu  Manajemen Perusahaan merealisasikan pencapaian sasaran melalui pemeriksaan kecukupan dan pelaksanaan proses pengendalian internal, manajemen  risiko,  dan  tata  kelola  perusahaan.  Keberadaan  SPI mendukung  pencapaian  target  usaha  yang  lebih  efektif  dalam mencegah penyimpangan.

## Struktur Organisasi Internal Audit

Kedudukan  Internal  Audit  dalam  struktur  organisasi  harus  setara dengan  peran  dan  tanggung  jawabnya  membantu  pengawasan Direktur Utama. Internal Audit perlu menyampaikan pendapat dan pemikiran  kepada  Manajemen  tanpa  dipengaruhi  atau  ditekan oleh pihak manapun. Group Head Internal Audit bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Direktur Utama.

Internal  Audit  membantu  Direktur  Utama  mengawasi  lingkungan organisasi  untuk  menjamin  bahwa  setiap  kegiatan  berjalan  sesuai peraturan, standar, program,  sistem dan prosedur  yang  telah ditetapkan.

To support the practice of Good Corporate Governance, the Company has an Internal Audit which is carried out by the Internal Audit Group which is directly responsible to the President Director based on the Decree of the Board of Directors of PT Berdikari No. 065/05/BDK/ DIR-01/VIII/2021 on August 31, 2021, concerning Determination of the Organizational Structure of PT Berdikari.

Internal  audit  is  part  of  internal  control,  which  generally  aims  to assist the Company's Management in realizing the achievement of targets through checking the adequacy and implementing processes of internal control, risk management and corporate governance. The existence of SPI supports the achievement of business targets that are more effective in preventing irregularities.

## Internal Audit Organizational Structure

The position of Internal Audit in the organizational structure must be equivalent to its role and responsibility in assisting the supervision of the President Director. Internal Audit needs to convey opinions and thoughts to Management without being influenced or pressured by any party. The Group Head of Internal Audit is directly responsible to the President Director.

Internal Audit assists the Main Director overseeing the organizational environment to ensure that every activity is carried out according to established regulations, standards, programs, systems and procedures.

## Piagam Satuan Pengawasan Internal

Group  Internal  Audit telah  memiliki  Piagam  Audit  Intern  ( Internal Audit  Charter )  yang  diterbitkan  pada  tanggal  23  September  2021 berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Direktur Utama Nomor:075/05/BDK/ DIR-01/IX/2021. Piagam  Audit  Intern dievaluasi secara berkala dan  ditandatangani  oleh  Komisaris  Utama  dan  Direktur  Utama Perusahaan. Secara garis besar, Piagam  Audit  Intern  memuat informasi  tujuan,  wewenang,  tanggung  jawab  dan  pokok-pokok kegiatan audit intern.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Tugas  dan  tanggung  jawab  Group  Internal  Audit  sebagaimana tercantum dalam Piagam Audit Intern adalah sebagai berikut:

1.  Membantu Direktur Utama dan Dewan Komisaris dalam melakukan  fungsi  pengawasan  terhadap  seluruh  Unit  Kerja  di perusahaan dan anak perusahaan, melalui pelaksanaan assurance dan consulting terhadap seluruh aspek di perusahaan;
2.  Menyampaikan  rencana  pengawasan  intern  kepada  Direktur Utama  setiap  tahun  yang  dituangkan  dalam  Program  Kerja Pengawasan Tahunan (PKPT);
3.  Memberikan jasa assurance kepada unit kerja intern perusahaan dan  anak  perusahaan  untuk  memberikan  nilai  tambah  dan perbaikan  terhadap  kualitas  pengendalian  intern,  pengelolaan risiko, dan tata kelola perusahaan;
4. Memberikan jasa konsultansi ( consulting ) kepada unit kerja intern perusahaan  untuk  memberikan  nilai  tambah  dan  perbaikan terhadap kualitas pengendalian intern, pengelolaan risiko, dan  tata  kelola  perusahaan  sepanjang  tidak  mempengaruhi independensi dan objektivitas Group Internal Audit, serta tersedia sumber daya yang memadai;
5.  Memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan dan menyediakan informasi yang  obyektif  dalam  bentuk  Laporan  Hasil  Pengawasan  dan menyampaikan  laporan  tersebut  kepada  Direktur  Utama,  dan Dewan Komisaris dengan salinannya kepada Komite Audit;
6. Memantau  tindak  lanjut  hasil  pengawasan  intern  dan  tindak lanjut hasil audit ekstern;
7. Melakukan  audit  pendalaman  sesuai  permintaan  Direksi,  atau sebagai tindak lanjut hasil audit umum ( general audit )  terhadap suatu  objek  atau  peristiwa  yang  diduga  mengandung  indikasi pelanggaran dan/atau fraud;
8. Berkoordinasi dan  melaksanakan  tugas  sebagai  mitra  kerja ( counterpart )  bagi auditor, asesor, dan/atau konsultan eksternal yang  terkait,  termasuk  jika  terdapat  pengawasan  intern  dari Fungsi Pengawasan Intern induk perusahaan ( holding );
9. Melakukan  audit  khusus  jika  diperlukan  dengan  persetujuan Direksi.

## Charter of the Internal Audit Unit

The Internal Audit Group already has an Internal Audit Charter issued on  September  23,  2021  based  on  the  Main  Director's  Decree  No: 075/05/BDK/DIR-01/IX/2021. The Internal Audit Charter is regularly evaluated  and  signed  by  the  President  Commissioner  and  the President Director of the Company. Broadly speaking, the Internal Audit  Charter  contains  information  on  the  objectives,  authorities, responsibilities and main points of internal audit activities.

## Duties and responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities of the Internal Audit Group as stated in the Internal Audit Charter are as follows:

1. Assisting the President Director and the Board of Commissioners in carrying out their oversight function of all Work Units in the company  and  its  subsidiaries,  through  the  implementation  of assurance and consulting on all aspects of the company;
2.  Delivering the internal control plan to the Main Director every year  as  outlined  in  the  Annual  Supervision  Work  Program (PKPT);
3. Providing  assurance  services  to  the  internal  work  units  of  the company and its subsidiaries to provide added value and improve the quality of internal control, risk management and corporate governance;
4.  Providing  consulting  services  to  the  company's  internal work units to provide added value and improve the quality of internal control, risk management and corporate governance as long as they do not affect the independence and  objectivity  of  the  Internal  Audit  Group,  and  adequate resources are available;
5. Providing recommendations for improvement and provide objective  information  in  the  form  of  a  Monitoring  Report  and submit  the  report  to  the  President  Director  and  the  Board  of Commissioners with a copy to the Audit Committee;
6. Monitoring the follow-up of internal audit results and the followup of external audit results;
7. Conducting  an  in-depth  audit  at  the  request  of  the  Board  of Directors, or as a follow-up to the results of a general audit of an  object  or  event  that  is  suspected  to  contain  indications  of violations and/or fraud;
8. Coordinating  and  carrying  out  duties  as  a  counterpart  for the  relevant  external  auditors,  assessors  and/or  consultants, including if there is internal control from the holding company's Internal Control Function;
9. Conducting special audits, if necessary, with the approval of the Board of Directors.

## Kode Etik Internal Audit

Personil Group  Internal  Audit harus  menerapkan  dan  menjunjung tinggi kode etik auditor intern, yaitu:

1. Integritas ( Integrity )
- a. Melaksanakan pekerjaan dengan menjunjung tinggi kejujuran, kehati-hatian dan penuh tanggung jawab;
- b.  Mematuhi seluruh undang-undang yang berlaku dan melakukan pengungkapan informasi yang diwajibkan berdasarkan hukum dan etika profesi yang berlaku;
- c. Tidak  secara  sengaja  meminta  orang  lain  untuk  melakukan perbuatan yang bertentangan dengan hukum atau melakukan tindakan  yang  dapat  mengurangi  kepercayaan  pada  profesi audit intern atau nama baik perusahaan;
- d.  Menghormati dan berkontribusi pada tujuan yang sah dan etis dari perusahaan.
2. Objektivitas ( Objectivity )
- a. Tidak  akan  terlibat  di  dalam  kegiatan  atau  hubungan  yang mengurangi atau diduga dapat mengurangi penilaian secara tidak memihak. Keterlibatan tersebut meliputi setiap kegiatan atau hubungan yang dapat menimbulkan benturan kepentingan di dalam perusahaan;
- b.  Tidak  menerima apapun yang berdampak atau diduga akan berdampak terhadap professional judgement;
- c. Senantiasa menggunakan professional judgement dalam pelaksanaan tugas pada kondisi dan situasi apapun;
- d.  Akan mengungkapkan seluruh fakta material yang diketahui, yang apabila tidak diungkapkan, dapat menimbulkan penyimpangan pada pelaporan kegiatan yang ditinjau.
3. Kerahasiaan ( Confidentiality )
- a. Bersikap hati-hati dalam penggunaan dan perlindungan informasi yang diperoleh selama pelaksanaan tugas;
- b.  Tidak akan menggunakan informasi untuk kepentingan pribadi atau dengan cara apapun yang bertentangan dengan hukum atau merugikan tujuan yang sah dan etis yang ditetapkan oleh organisasi.
4.  Kompetensi ( Competency )
- a. Melaksanakan tugas sesuai dengan pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan pengalaman yang dimiliki;
- b.  Melaksanakan pengawasan intern sesuai dengan International Standards  for  Professional  Practice  of  Internal  Auditing/ Standar IIA;
- c. Senantiasa meningkatkan keahlian, kompetensi, serta efektivitas, dan kualitas hasil pekerjaan.

## Internal Audit Competency Development

In  order  to  improve  competency  in  carrying  out  its  duties  and responsibilities, Internal Audit plays an active role in participating in various training and education programs that are tailored to business developments and industry trends when deemed necessary. Training is provided both by the Company's internal parties and also external parties  of  the  Company.  Information  regarding  the  training  and competency  development  activities  that  the  Internal  Audit  will participate in in 2022 can be seen in the Company Profile chapter in this annual report.

## Ethics of Internal Audit

Group  Internal  Audit  personnel  must  implement  and  uphold  the internal auditor code of ethics, namely:

1. Integrity
- a. Upholding honesty, prudence and full responsibility at work;
- b.  Complying with all applicable laws and disclose information required by law and professional ethics;
- c. Not intentionally requesting others to take actions that are against  the  law  or  take  actions  that  can  reduce  confidence in  the  internal  audit  profession  or  the  good  name  of  the company;
- d. Respecting  and  contributing  to  the  legitimate  and  ethical goals of the company.
2. Objectivity
- a. Not involved in activities or relationships that reduce or are suspected of reducing impartial judgment. This involvement includes  any  activities  or  relationships  that  may  cause  a conflict of interest within the company;
- b. Not accepting any matter that has an impact or is suspected to have an impact on professional judgment;
- c. Use  professional  judgment  in  carrying  out  tasks  in  any condition and situation;
- d. Willing  to  disclose  all  known  material  facts,  which,  if  not disclosed,  could  lead  to  deviations  in  the  reporting  of  the activities being reviewed.
3. Confidentiality
- a. Be careful in the use and protection of information obtained during the execution of tasks;
- b. Willing not to use information for personal gain or in any way that is against the law or detrimental to the legitimate and ethical goals set by the organization.
4.  Competency
- a. Performing tasks based on the knowledge, skills and experience possessed;
- b.  Conducting internal control in accordance with the International Standards for Professional Practice of Internal Auditing/IIA Standards;
- c. Constantly improving skills, competencies, as well as effectiveness and quality of work results.
